writing:wr:106.hint: 国際的な平和の実現に貢献するという意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:106.answer: The Olympic Games can contribute to world peace.
writing:wr:106.fullSentence: The Olympic Games can contribute to world peace.
writing:wr:106.explanation: 世界平和に貢献するという意味。

writing:wr:107.hint: これまでにない最高の記録を打ち立てることを表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:107.answer: The swimmer set a new world record at the competition.

writing:wr:107.explanation: 世界記録を樹立するという意味。

writing:wr:108.hint: 死刑制度をそのまま維持し続けることを表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:108.answer: Some governments choose to retain capital punishment.

writing:wr:108.explanation: 死刑を存続させるという意味。

writing:wr:109.hint: 死刑の判決を受けて刑の執行を待つ受刑者を表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:109.answer: A death-row prisoner spent years waiting for the final decision.
writing:wr:109.fullSentence: A death-row prisoner spent years waiting for the final decision.

writing:wr:110.hint: 行った罪の重さに応じて死刑がふさわしいと考えられることを表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:110.answer: Many people believe that such a brutal crime deserves capital punishment.
writing:wr:110.fullSentence: Many people believe that such a brutal crime deserves capital punishment.
writing:wr:110.explanation: 死刑に値するという意味。

writing:wr:111.hint: 法律や制度が憲法の理念に反していることを表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:111.answer: Critics argue that the law may be unconstitutional.
writing:wr:111.fullSentence: Critics argue that the law may be unconstitutional.
writing:wr:111.explanation: 違憲であるという意味。

writing:wr:112.hint: 亡くなった人の家族が残されている状況を表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:112.answer: The bereaved family asked for a fair trial.
writing:wr:112.fullSentence: The bereaved family asked for a fair trial.

writing:wr:113.hint: 誤った証拠によって無実の人が有罪とされてしまう事件を表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:113.answer: There have been several cases of false accusation in the past.
writing:wr:113.fullSentence: There have been several cases of false accusation in the past.

writing:wr:114.hint: 自転車に乗る人が交通規則を守らないことを表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:114.answer: Some cyclists violate traffic regulations by riding on the wrong side.
writing:wr:114.fullSentence: Some cyclists violate traffic regulations by riding on the wrong side.
writing:wr:114.explanation: 交通違反をするという意味。

writing:wr:115.hint: 太陽の光を利用した車を日常生活で使えるようにすることを表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:115.answer: Engineers are trying to put a solar car to practical use.

writing:wr:115.explanation: ソーラーカーを実用化するという意味。

writing:wr:116.hint: 雨が少なくなり土地が荒れて砂の地になっていく現象を表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:116.answer: Overgrazing has accelerated desertification in the region.
writing:wr:116.fullSentence: Overgrazing has accelerated desertification in the region.

writing:wr:117.hint: 工場から出る不要な物質を処理する必要があることを表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:117.answer: Companies must properly dispose of industrial waste.

writing:wr:118.explanation: 使い捨ての時代だという意味。

writing:wr:119.hint: 汚染がひどい地域から人々が避難することを表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:119.answer: Residents had to evacuate from highly contaminated areas.

writing:wr:119.explanation: 高汚染地域から避難するという意味。

writing:wr:120.hint: 石油や石炭を燃やして電気を作る発電方法を表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:120.answer: Thermal power generation still supplies much of the electricity in Japan.
writing:wr:120.fullSentence: Thermal power generation still supplies much of the electricity in Japan.

writing:wr:121.hint: 結婚せず家庭で家事を担う女性の立場を表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:121.answer: Her mother has always been a stay-at-home wife.
writing:wr:121.fullSentence: Her mother has always been a stay-at-home wife.

writing:wr:122.hint: 結婚する年齢が以前より上がっていく傾向を表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:122.answer: The trend toward later marriage is growing stronger in Japan.

writing:wr:122.explanation: 晩婚化の傾向という意味。

writing:wr:123.answer: Japan will run short of labor as the population ages.
writing:wr:123.fullSentence: Japan will run short of labor as the population ages.
writing:wr:123.explanation: 労働力不足になるという意味。

writing:wr:124.hint: 出産する女性社員に休暇を認める制度を表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:124.answer: The firm now allows female workers to take maternity leave.
writing:wr:124.fullSentence: The firm now allows female workers to take maternity leave.

writing:wr:124.explanation: 産休を認めるという意味。

writing:wr:125.hint: 子供を預けられる施設をもっと増やすことを表す表現は何か。

writing:wr:125.explanation: 保育所を増やすという意味。

writing:wr:126.cat: 日本文化・学校生活・旅行

writing:wr:127.fullSentence: The old teacher had an air of dignity that students respected.
writing:wr:127.explanation: 威厳があるという意味。

writing:wr:128.explanation: 感銘を受けるという意味。

writing:wr:129.answer: Math is a required subject for all first-year students.
writing:wr:129.fullSentence: Math is a required subject for all first-year students.

writing:wr:130.answer: Students can visit the career guidance office for advice.
